```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)

```

```{r}
# Path to your GSE folder
folder <- "../../GSE117295_RAW/"

# List all CSV files in the folder
files <- list.files(folder, pattern = "_CT[0-9]+.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Create a list to store Seurat objects for each timepoint
seurat_list <- list()

for (f in files) {
  # Use filename (without extension) as timepoint ID
  timepoint <- stringr::str_extract(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f)), pattern = "(?<=CT).*")
  
  # Read in the CSV
  dat <- read.csv(f, row.names = 1) 
  
  # Create Seurat object
  seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = dat, project = timepoint)
  
  # Add metadata for timepoint
  seu$timepoint <- as.numeric(timepoint)
  
  # Store in list
  seurat_list[[timepoint]] <- seu
}

# Add orig.ident as a postfix to cell names for each object in the list
seurat_list <- lapply(seurat_list, function(obj) {
  RenameCells(obj, new.names = paste0(colnames(obj), "_", obj$orig.ident))
})

# Merge all Seurat objects into one
combined <- merge(seurat_list[[1]], y = seurat_list[-1])

# Check metadata
head(combined@meta.data)

```

```{r}

is_cycling_custom <- function(times, pb_mat,meta_data, time_units = "hrs") {
  `%do%` <- foreach::`%do%`
  cat(paste("\nRunning is_cycling()"))
  gene1 = t(pb_mat)  # get the transpose, subjects x genes and put in order of CYCLOPS order
   if(time_units == "hrs"){
   cat(paste("\nRunning regression, converting hours to radians"))
   times1 = times / 12 * pi
  } else{
    cat(paste("\nRunning regression assuming times are 0-2pi radians"))
    times1 = times
  }
  batches = meta_data$batch[match(colnames(pb_mat), meta_data$timepoint)] %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.factor()
 
    #loop:
  all_genes = foreach (gene_i = 1:ncol(gene1), .combine = rbind) %do%{
    gexp1 = as.numeric(unlist(gene1[,gene_i]))
    Gene_Symbols = colnames(gene1)[gene_i]
    # Check for all zeros or zero variance
    if (all(gexp1 == 0) || sd(gexp1) == 0) {
      # Return NA row for this gene
      return(c(Gene_Symbols, rep(NA, 11))) # columns to match the number of outputs
    }
    
    partial_model = lm(gexp1 ~ batches)
    partial_model_AIC = AIC(partial_model)
    partial_model_BIC = BIC(partial_model)
    
    full_model = lm(gexp1 ~ sin(times1) + cos(times1)+batches )
    full_model_AIC = AIC(full_model)
    full_model_BIC = BIC(full_model)
    
    design_matrix <- model.matrix(gexp1 ~ sin(times1) + cos(times1)+batches)
    
    anova_results = anova(partial_model, full_model)
    sin_coff = full_model[["coefficients"]][["sin(times1)"]]
    cos_coeff = full_model[["coefficients"]][["cos(times1)"]]
    acrophase_bulk = atan2(sin_coff, cos_coeff) %% (2*pi)
    
    p_statistic = anova_results$`Pr(>F)`[2]
    amplitude_bulk = sqrt(sin_coff^2 + cos_coeff^2)
    
    mesor_bulk = mean(design_matrix[,-c(2, 3)] %*% full_model[["coefficients"]][-c(2, 3)]) 
    # mesor_bulk = full_model$coefficients[["(Intercept)"]]
    
    amp_ratio = amplitude_bulk / mesor_bulk
    
    
    
   gene_summary = cbind( Gene_Symbols, acrophase_bulk,amplitude_bulk,
              p_statistic, amp_ratio, sin_coff, cos_coeff, mesor_bulk,
              partial_model_AIC, full_model_AIC, partial_model_BIC, full_model_BIC)
    
    return(gene_summary)
    
  }
  all_genes = as_tibble(all_genes) %>% drop_na
  all_genes$BHQ = p.adjust(as.numeric(all_genes$p_statistic), "BH")
  all_genes$Bonf = p.adjust(as.numeric(all_genes$p_statistic), "bonferroni")
  return(all_genes)
  
}

var_cycling_custom <- function(times, var_mat, mean_mat, phase_pb,meta_data, time_units = "hrs") {
  `%do%` <- foreach::`%do%`
  cat(paste("\nRunning var_cycling()"))
  gene1 = t(var_mat)  # get the transpose, subjects x genes and put in order of CYCLOPS order
  means1 = t(mean_mat)
  if(time_units == "hrs"){
    cat(paste("\nRunning regression, converting hours to radians"))
    times1 = times / 12 * pi
  } else{
    cat(paste("\nRunning regression assuming times are 0-2pi radians"))
    times1 = times
  }
  batches = meta_data$batch[match(colnames(pb_mat), meta_data$timepoint)] %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.factor()
  
  #loop:
  all_genes = foreach (gene_i = 1:ncol(gene1), .combine = rbind) %do%{
    gexp1 = as.numeric(unlist(gene1[,gene_i]))
    m1 = as.numeric(unlist(means1[, gene_i]))
    Gene_Symbols = colnames(gene1)[gene_i]
    phase_bulk = as.numeric(phase_pb[gene_i])


    # Check for all zeros or zero variance
    if (all(m1 == 0) || all(gexp1 == 0) || sd(m1) == 0 || sd(gexp1) == 0) {
      # Return NA row for this gene
      return(c(Gene_Symbols, rep(NA, 11))) #  columns to match the number of outputs
    }
    
    partial_model = lm(gexp1 ~ m1 + batches)
    partial_model_AIC = AIC(partial_model)
    partial_model_BIC = BIC(partial_model)

    full_model = lm(gexp1 ~ sin(2*times1) + cos(2*times1) + m1 + batches)
    full_model_AIC = AIC(full_model)
    full_model_BIC = BIC(full_model)

    design_matrix <- model.matrix(gexp1 ~ sin(2*times1) + cos(2*times1) + m1 + batches)
    
    anova_results = anova(partial_model, full_model)
    sin_coff = full_model[["coefficients"]][["sin(2 * times1)"]]
    cos_coeff = full_model[["coefficients"]][["cos(2 * times1)"]]
    double_freq_acrophase = atan2(sin_coff, cos_coeff) %% (2*pi) / 2

    #What is the amplitude of the fundamental according to the double frequency model?
    find_Af = lm(full_model$coefficients[["m1"]]*m1 ~ cos(times1) + sin(times1))
    fund_amp = sqrt(find_Af$coefficients[["sin(times1)"]]^2 + find_Af$coefficients[["cos(times1)"]]^2)
    fund_acro = atan2(find_Af$coefficients[["sin(times1)"]], find_Af$coefficients[["cos(times1)"]]) %% (2*pi)
    
    
    double_freq_p_statistic = anova_results$`Pr(>F)`[2]
    raw_2w_amp = sqrt(sin_coff^2 + cos_coeff^2)

    # #Calculate the 95% CI for double frequency phase
    # if(double_freq_amplitude > 1e-3){
    #   ## Extract coefficients and covariance ---------------
    #   b  <- coef(full_model)["cos(2 * times1)"]   # β̂
    #   g  <- coef(full_model)["sin(2 * times1)"]   # γ̂
    #   V  <- vcov(full_model)[c("cos(2 * times1)","sin(2 * times1)"),
    #                   c("cos(2 * times1)","sin(2 * times1)")]

    #   ## SE via delta method -------------------------------
    #   var.phi <- (g^2*V[1,1] + b^2*V[2,2] - 2*b*g*V[1,2]) / (b^2+g^2)^2
    #   se.phi  <- sqrt(var.phi)
    #   ## 95 % CI (in radians) ------------------------------
    #   phi.hat <- atan2(g, b)
    #   ci.phi  <- phi.hat + c(-1, 1)*qnorm(0.975)*se.phi
    # }
    
    #Amp of double frequency variance wave projected onto expected bulk wave.
    double_freq_amplitude = -cos_coeff * cos(2 * phase_bulk) - sin_coff * sin(2 * phase_bulk)

    #MESOR or mean of the fitted variance wave
    # var_mesor = mean( full_model$fitted.values)
    var_mesor = mean(design_matrix[,-c(2, 3)] %*% full_model[["coefficients"]][-c(2, 3)])

    gene_summary = cbind( Gene_Symbols, double_freq_acrophase, double_freq_amplitude,
          double_freq_p_statistic, fund_amp, fund_acro, var_mesor,
          partial_model_AIC, full_model_AIC, partial_model_BIC, full_model_BIC, raw_2w_amp)
    
    
    
    return(gene_summary)
    
  }
  all_genes = as_tibble(all_genes) %>% drop_na
  all_genes$BHQ = p.adjust(as.numeric(all_genes$double_freq_p_statistic), "BH")
  all_genes$Bonf = p.adjust(as.numeric(all_genes$double_freq_p_statistic), "bonferroni")
  return(all_genes)
  
}
```

### Do Orpheus:

```{r}
neuron_sub_obj = joined_seurat_obj
neuron_sub_obj$seurat_clusters = neuron_sub_obj$neuron_subcluster
obj = neuron_sub_obj#seurat_obj_coarse#
cluster_phis = list()
for(cell_type in names(table(obj$seurat_clusters))){
  
print(paste("Analyzing", cell_type))

# tmp = extract_clstr_prep_input(seurat_obj, cluster_id = cell_type, clip_sd = 15, normalize = T)
tmp = extract_clstr_prep_input(obj, cluster_id = cell_type, normalize = T)
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]

#Variance of NB is var = mean + mean^2*theta
#rearrange to solve for theta = (var-mean)/mean^2
# time_wise_theta_meas <- as.data.frame(mapply(function(v,m){(v-m)/m^2}, var_mat, pb_mat))
# rownames(time_wise_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)
# colnames(time_wise_theta_meas) = paste0(colnames(time_wise_theta_meas), "_theta_meas")
vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(counts)
means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(counts)
agg_theta_meas = data.frame(coarse_theta = (vars-means)/means^2)
rownames(agg_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)


#Recover time in hours that sample was collected

matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
print(ZT)
# ZT = as.numeric(colnames(pb_mat))

#Call cosinor regression methods, where phases of variance wave are NOT fixed:
pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat, time_units = "hrs")
# pb_cycling = is_cycling_custom(ZT, pb_mat, meta_data = obj@meta.data, time_units = "hrs")

phase_pb = pb_cycling %>% select(Gene_Symbols, acrophase_bulk)

var_mat = var_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]
pb_mat = pb_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]

stopifnot(all(rownames(pb_mat) == pb_cycling$Gene_Symbols))
phase_pb_num = phase_pb$acrophase_bulk %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric
#hist(as.numeric(phase_pb))

var_cyclers = var_cycling(times = ZT, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = phase_pb_num)

bulk_amp_thr = 0.1

input_cos = var_cyclers %>% 
    left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix=c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_amp_thr) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)

phi <- tryCatch(
  {
    calc_phi(pb_cycling, var_cyclers, cycling_p_thr = 0.05, bulk_amp_thr = bulk_amp_thr)
  },
  error = function(e) {
    message("calc_phi failed: ", e$message)
    return(NA)   # or NULL, or some safe default
  }
)
if(all(is.na(phi))){
 next
}

plot_rhythms(ZT, var_mat, pb_mat, plot_me = c("Akap17b"))

output_cos_tmm = merge(phi, input_cos, by = 0)
# output = merge(output_cos_tmm, time_wise_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)
output = merge(output_cos_tmm, agg_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)


local_res =  list("tmm" = output)
names(local_res) =cell_type
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))
}
```

```{r}
 # Shaded region for the published data range for easy comparison
 geom_rect(
   data = published_points,
   aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
       ymin = min(phi), ymax = max(phi)),
   fill = "grey90", alpha = 0.5
 ) +
  # Boxplots for the ORPHEUS data
  geom_boxplot(
    data = orpheus_df,
    aes(x = cell_type, y = phi_hrs, fill = cell_type),
    width = 0.5,
    outlier.shape = NA # We will plot the points ourselves
  ) +
  # Violin for the ORPHEUS data
  # geom_violin(
  #   data = orpheus_df,
  #   aes(x = cell_type, y = phi_hrs, fill = cell_type)
  # ) +
  

  # Individual gene points (jittered) for ORPHEUS data
  geom_jitter(
    data = orpheus_df, 
    aes(x = cell_type, y = phi_hrs), 
    alpha = 0.7,
    position = position_jitter(width = jitter_width, seed = jitter_seed)
  ) +
  
  # # The published data point estimate with error bars
  # geom_pointrange(
  #   data = published_summary,
  #   aes(x = cell_type, y = mean_phi, ymin = mean_phi - sd_phi, ymax = mean_phi + sd_phi),

  #   color = "black",
  #   shape = 18 # A diamond shape to distinguish it
  # ) +
    # The published data point estimates
  geom_point(
    data = published_points,
    aes(x = cell_type, y = phi),
    alpha = 0.7,
    color = "black",
  ) +
  
  # The Gene Labels (using ggrepel)
  geom_text_repel(
    data = orpheus_df,
    aes(x = cell_type, y = phi_hrs, label = gene_label),
    position = position_jitter(width = jitter_width, seed = jitter_seed),
    box.padding = 0.5,         # More space around labels
    point.padding = 0.5,       # Space from the point
    min.segment.length = 0,    # Draw lines even for close labels
    max.overlaps = Inf,        # Ensure all labels are shown
    fontface = "italic",       # Italicize gene names
    size = 4,
  ) +
  
  # Aesthetics and Labels
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("SCN Vip+/Nms+\nneurons" = "#018571", "SCN Cck+/Bdnf+\nneurons" = "#dfc27d")) +
  labs(
    title = "ORPHEUS Quantifies Cell-Type-Specific Synchrony in the SCN",
    subtitle = "Phase dispersion estimates are consistent with experimental data from PER2::luc assays",
    x = "", # No x-axis label needed
    y = "Phase dispersion (hrs)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(

    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),   # Increase y-axis title size
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),   # Increase legend title size
  )
```

Do Orpheus on all SCN cells as one cell type:

```{r}
obj = seurat_obj_coarse
cell_type = "SCN"
print(paste("Analyzing", cell_type))

tmp = extract_clstr_prep_input(obj, cluster_id = cell_type, normalize = T)
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]

vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(counts)
means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(counts)
agg_theta_meas = data.frame(coarse_theta = (vars-means)/means^2)
rownames(agg_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)

#Recover time in hours that sample was collected

matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
print(ZT)

#Call cosinor regression methods, where phases of variance wave are NOT fixed:
pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat, time_units = "hrs")
phase_pb = pb_cycling %>% select(Gene_Symbols, acrophase_bulk)

var_mat = var_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]
pb_mat = pb_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]

stopifnot(all(rownames(pb_mat) == pb_cycling$Gene_Symbols))
phase_pb_num = phase_pb$acrophase_bulk %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric

var_cyclers = var_cycling(times = ZT, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = phase_pb_num)

bulk_amp_thr = 0.1

input_cos = var_cyclers %>% 
    left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix=c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_amp_thr) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)
phi <- tryCatch(
  {
    calc_phi(pb_cycling, var_cyclers, cycling_p_thr = 0.05, bulk_amp_thr = bulk_amp_thr)
  },
  error = function(e) {
    message("calc_phi failed: ", e$message)
    return(NA)   # or NULL, or some safe default
  }
)


output_cos_tmm = merge(phi, input_cos, by = 0)

output = merge(output_cos_tmm, agg_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)
output$Source = "SCN"
```

Do Orpheus with Pseudoreplicates:

```{r}
obj = seurat_obj_coarse
cluster_phis = list()
for(cell_type in unique(obj$seurat_clusters)){
  

for(seed in c(1:4))  {
print(paste("Analyzing", cell_type, "seed", seed))



# tmp = extract_clstr_prep_input(seurat_obj, cluster_id = cell_type, clip_sd = 15, normalize = T)
tmp = extract_clstr_prep_input(obj, cluster_id = cell_type, normalize = T, num_replicates = 2, random_seed = seed)
pb_mat = tmp[[1]]
var_mat = tmp[[2]]
counts = tmp[[3]]

#Variance of NB is var = mean + mean^2*theta
#rearrange to solve for theta = (var-mean)/mean^2
time_wise_theta_meas <- as.data.frame(mapply(function(v,m){(v-m)/m^2}, var_mat, pb_mat))
rownames(time_wise_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)
colnames(time_wise_theta_meas) = paste0(colnames(time_wise_theta_meas), "_theta_meas")
vars = sparseMatrixStats::rowVars(counts)
means = sparseMatrixStats::rowMeans2(counts)
agg_theta_meas = data.frame(coarse_theta = (vars-means)/means^2)
rownames(agg_theta_meas) = rownames(pb_mat)


#Recover time in hours that sample was collected

matches <- stringr::str_match(colnames(pb_mat) , "(\\d+)")
ZT = as.numeric(matches[,2])
# ZT = as.numeric(colnames(pb_mat))

#Call cosinor regression methods, where phases of variance wave are NOT fixed:
pb_cycling = is_cycling(ZT, pb_mat, time_units = "hrs")

phase_pb = pb_cycling %>% select(Gene_Symbols, acrophase_bulk)

var_mat = var_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]
pb_mat = pb_mat[phase_pb$Gene_Symbols,]

all(rownames(pb_mat) == pb_cycling$Gene_Symbols)
phase_pb_num = phase_pb$acrophase_bulk %>% unname %>% unlist %>% as.numeric
#hist(as.numeric(phase_pb))

var_cyclers = var_cycling(times = ZT, var_mat = var_mat, mean_mat = pb_mat, phase_pb = phase_pb_num)

bulk_amp_thr = 0.1

input_cos = var_cyclers %>% 
    left_join(pb_cycling, by = "Gene_Symbols", suffix=c("_var", "_pb")) %>%
    mutate(across(-Gene_Symbols, as.numeric)) %>%
    filter(p_statistic < 0.05) %>%
    mutate(acrodiff = (double_freq_acrophase - acrophase_bulk) %% pi) %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Symbols, double_freq_amplitude,fund_amp,amplitude_bulk, mesor_bulk, everything()) %>%
    filter(amplitude_bulk >= bulk_amp_thr) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Gene_Symbols")%>%
    filter(partial_model_AIC_var > full_model_AIC_var)
    #filter(partial_model_BIC_var > full_model_BIC_var)

phi <- tryCatch(
  {
    calc_phi(pb_cycling, var_cyclers, cycling_p_thr = 0.05, bulk_amp_thr = bulk_amp_thr, info_criterion = "AIC")
  },
  error = function(e) {
    message("calc_phi failed: ", e$message)
    return(NA)   # or NULL, or some safe default
  }
)
if(all(is.na(phi))){
 next
}

# plot_rhythms(ZT, var_mat, pb_mat, plot_me = c("Pam"))

output_cos_tmm = merge(phi, input_cos, by = 0)
output = merge(output_cos_tmm, time_wise_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)
output = merge(output, agg_theta_meas, by.x = "Row.names", by.y = 0)

local_res =  list("tmm" = output)
names(local_res) = paste0(cell_type,"_seed" ,seed)
cluster_phis <- append(cluster_phis, list(local_res))
}
}
```

```{r}
cos_phis_tmm <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(cluster_phis), function(source_name) {
  current_df <- cluster_phis[[source_name]][[1]]
  current_df$Source <- names(cluster_phis[[source_name]][1])
  current_df
}))


cos_phis_tmm_filt = filter(cos_phis_tmm, !is.nan(phi))
table(cos_phis_tmm_filt$Source)

phis_filt <- cos_phis_tmm_filt %>%
  separate(Source, into = c("cell", "seed"), sep = "_seed")

phis_consensus = phis_filt %>%
  group_by(cell, Row.names) %>%
  mutate(n_seeds = n_distinct(seed)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n_seeds == 4)

#Now phis_consensus has repeat genes for each "seed"
#gene count by cell type:
phis_consensus %>% group_by(cell) %>% summarize(n_genes = n_distinct(Row.names))

pval_cols = c("p_statistic", "double_freq_p_statistic")
phis_seed_avg <- phis_consensus %>%
  select(!contains("acrophase") & !contains("AIC") & !contains("BIC")) %>%
  group_by(cell, Row.names) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(pval_cols), max, na.rm = TRUE),
    across(where(is.numeric) & !all_of(pval_cols), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = T)),
    cell = first(cell),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 
```
